superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I would widen Observer’s frame: air-quality sensors and parking also share the reception silence, so I cannot locate its cause in a neighborhood [F2][F3][F4]. I take Skeptic’s correction further: the repeated Blic headline makes these links dependent clues, not independent corroboration [F36][F37][F38].
hypotheses_sr: Sumnjam na zajednički prekid prikupljanja pre nego na prostorni obrazac u gradu, ali sažeci prijema ne mogu da ih razlikuju [F2][F3][F4].
